ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a right triangle PQR, with a right-angle mark at vertex Q. PQ is the vertical side, labeled 72; QR is the horizontal side, labeled 25; what is requested is the angle at vertex R. Reasoning: For angle R, PQ=72 is the opposite side, and QR=25 is the adjacent side, so tan(R)=72/25. Calculate R=arctan(72/25)=arctan(2.88)≈70.9°. Therefore angle R to the nearest tenth is 70.9°.
